Why now
Healthcare AI is moving into the home. We built it a clinically grounded place to train.
01 · e.g. 1X NEO, Figure

Humanoid & home robots

About to share homes with older adults. They have to know a towel bar is not a grab bar.

02 · e.g. Meta Ray-Ban Display

Smart glasses & wearables

Seeing the home through the user's eyes, in every room the patient walks through.

03 · discharge, monitoring, caregiving

Home-health & care apps

A wave of apps assessing homes from a phone camera, all judging safety from pixels.

Every one needs to be tested before it meets a patient. Today the only test is real patients. HealthDojo is the dojo: validated, guideline-grounded environments where models and apps train and get pressure-tested.

Who it's for

For the teams putting AI in the home. Find the edge cases, train on them.

01 · Home robots

Humanoids & home robots

Find and train on hazard-perception edge cases in walkable 3D homes before sharing a hallway with an 80-year-old on a walker.

02 · Smart glasses & wearables

Vision on the patient's face

See what the device notices, and what it misses, from the user's own point of view. Then train on the misses.

03 · Home-health & care apps

Edge cases before the pilot

Discharge, remote-monitoring and caregiver apps find their blind spots on synthetic homes instead of real patients.

What you get
A private simulator from your guidelineYour protocol, your rooms, your hazard list, compiled into labelled homes and 3D worlds.
Hard-example training packsEvery edge case your model misses, turned into labelled training data at the level where it breaks.
Re-run on every model releaseSame simulator, new checkpoint: regressions show up before they reach a patient.
Later Hospitals and payers under CJR-X: the rating they require.
Every failure we find becomes new training data, and the simulator gets harder.
The stack
Built in one day on AWS.
Built in one day at the Healthcare AI Hackathon, AWS Builder Loft, San Francisco. HomeBench is open on GitHub.
Powered byAWSAnthropicGoogle GeminiStability AIWorld LabsElevenLabsOpenAIGitHub
Model access
AWS Bedrock

13 of 14 models we tested run on Bedrock: Claude, OpenAI GPT-5.6 via Bedrock, Nova, Llama 4, Qwen3-VL, Mistral, Gemma, Kimi, Grok, Nemotron.

Rubric + judge
Claude Sonnet 5 and Claude Opus 5.5

Sonnet 5 on Bedrock drafts cited rubric rows; the verifier checks every scene before it counts. Grading against labels is deterministic, no LLM grades the answers.

Image generation
Stability AI on Bedrock + Gemini 3 Pro Image

Clean rooms, then hazards painted in one label at a time.

3D worlds
World Labs Marble

Gaussian-splat homes with collision meshes, walkable in the browser.

Agent environment
Custom look-around harness

Models choose where to look, then flag what they find.

Voice
ElevenLabs

Narrates each walkthrough step.

Hosting
Amazon S3 + GitHub

Static site on S3; code and benchmark open on GitHub.
